title: Romantic Getaway to Delhi: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Delhi. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Delhi sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Adventure Crew
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Delhi. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Delhi for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Delhi
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Delhi](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1598977054780-2dc700fdc9d3?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of India's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Boutique hotels in Delhi offer intimate settings with personalized service perfect for couples.
